Recommendation: Identify other processes with greater impact potential. Request a full operational diagnosis.

faq.title: Frequently asked questions
faq.q1Question: How do I know if the % improvement I selected is realistic?
faq.q1Answer: It depends on the current process. Very manual processes with many unnecessary steps can improve 50-70%. Already semi-optimized processes can improve 15-30%. In a free diagnosis we evaluate your specific process and estimate a realistic improvement based on our experience.
faq.q2Question: Does the cost include only consulting or also tools?
faq.q2Answer: The project cost should include: consulting (design + implementation), tools/software if needed, team training. In the diagnosis we detail the breakdown. Typically: 60% consulting, 25% tools, 15% training.
faq.q3Answer: Results depend on disciplined execution and team adoption. We base estimates on experience (20+ optimization projects) but each case has particularities. In formal projects, we include baseline measurement and post-implementation metric tracking to validate actual savings.
faq.q4Question: Does the calculator only apply to administrative or also operational processes?
faq.q4Answer: It applies to any repetitive process: administrative (approvals, onboarding), operational (production, logistics), sales (quotes, contracts), support (customer service). If the process runs multiple times, involves people, and consumes time, it can be optimized.

intro.title: How digital is your company?
intro.subtitle: Digital Maturity Assessment in 5 minutes.
intro.description: Answer 20 questions about strategy, digital channels, data, and technology. You will receive a maturity score (0-100), your level vs industry benchmark, and prioritized recommendations.
